dialogues.speaker: Farrokhzadan Journal (I)
dialogues.text: "...Lunja had a big deal with some snow land merchants in Port Ormos. Helped them dispose of a traitor or something. Anyway, we made a fortune..."

dialogues.speaker: Farrokhzadan Journal (I)
dialogues.text: "...That was enough for us to rest a few months. And to celebrate, Lunja brought us here to play Genius Invokation TCG, some most trending game in town..."

dialogues.speaker: Farrokhzadan Journal (I)
dialogues.text: "...Don't know why she's so drawn to the city chic. But considering how we ended up playing dice last time, we all had a bad feeling about this..."
